decision_cruda.rationale: E569-01 stopped 5-8h, so LH-03 is idle. Activate RS-E595-01 (9.8 g/t, 293 t, 0.5 h activation, 0.33 h travel) in Este. Este is not truck-limited (inflow 33 vs 72 t/h), so the extra ore reaches surface. About 6 loading hours at 38.5 t/h gives roughly 230 t, or about 73 oz. RS-E595-03 is lower grade (about 46 oz). RS-N574-02 is in Norte, which is truck-limited. No loans: no producing place has a loader to spare.
